RIGD.description: Rigid Link (RIGD). The key is the master node number (entity key); ITEMS holds one or more rigid-link definitions, each pairing a constrained degree-of-freedom code (DOF) with the list of slave nodes rigidly connected to that master node.

ITEMS.description: List of rigid-link definitions attached to the master node given by the key. Each item is applied on OnSet by resolving its group and slave-type key.

ID.description: Serial number of the rigid-link entry under the master node. Optional; defaults to 0 (auto). On update, must match the existing serial for the resolved slave-type/group or the request is rejected.

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary group name. Optional; empty string means no group. If non-empty it must reference an existing boundary group, otherwise the request fails.

DOF.description: Constrained degree-of-freedom code for the slave nodes (nSlaveType). Six-digit flag read as DX DY DZ RX RY RZ from the 6th to the 1st decimal place; 1 = rigidly constrained to the master, 0 = free (e.g. 111111 constrains all six DOF).

S_NODE.description: Slave node numbers rigidly linked to the master node. On set the list replaces the existing slave nodes.
